$comment: The canon's own stamp. role canon-home means the surface and overlay checks do not apply - this repo ships rules, not a product. The digest was recomputed from the live rule set on this adoption date.

exemptions.reason: The dated history of a project record keeps the words of the day it was written (rules/contrib/history/README.md); fixing its typography would rewrite a record of what was found. The facts records one folder up are living prose and are checked.
Same as SZA-STYLE01: the dated history is not restyled.
